title: Preparing For Tomorrow's Energy Needs
summary: Prepare for the future of energy with insights on rising demand and strategic planning from Evergy Energy Partners to ensure reliable and affordable electricity.
body_markdown:
Whether you are expanding a business, planning community growth, managing a municipal utility, or supporting economic development initiatives, understanding today’s energy landscape is more important than ever.

For many years, electricity demand growth remained relatively stagnant across much of the United States. Today, that trend is changing. New technologies, economic development projects, and electrification initiatives are increasing energy needs in many regions. As


a result, utilities across the country are experiencing a renewed period of electricity demand growth.


What is Driving Electricity Demand?


While the electricity demand was


relatively stable for many years


, today’s economy is becoming increasingly dependent on reliable electric power.


Several trends are occurring simultaneously:


- Growth in digital infrastructure.
- Manufacturing expansion and initiatives.
- Electrification of transportation and equipment.
- Population and economic growth.
- Emerging technologies and evolving energy needs.


Gro


wth in digital infrastructure


, cloud computing, and emerging artificial intelligence (AI) applications—is contributing to increased electricity demand in some regions


. At the same time, manufacturing investments, electrification, population growth, and economic development activity are also increasing power needs across the country.


Manufacturing


growth


- including investments in advanced technologies, battery technology, and energy storage - is creating additional demand as companies invest in n


ew facilities and expand existing operations. These economic development projects require significant energy resources, making reliable power an essential component of business growth and competitiveness


.


Growing electricity demand affects more than just utilities. It influences customers, communities, and local economies. From industrial operations to building technologies and transportation systems, electrification is increasing energy needs


across multiple sectors.


The Challenge of Meeting Future Demand


Meeting the future electricity demand is more than simply building new power plants. New power generation must be coordinated with substation , transmission,


and distribution networks that deliver electricity to customers.


Utilities must also account for changing technologies, evolving customer expectations, weather impacts, regulatory requirements, federal policy, and long-term growth forecasts. Maintaining a reliable and affordable energy supply requires balancing all of these factors simultaneously.


As the energy landscape becomes more complex, utilities are rethinking how they plan for the future. These evolving trends require both utilities and customers to continuously evaluate planning assumptions and adapt long-term strategies to changing conditions.


Key Considerations


Planning for future growth requires utilities and customers to better understand how demand patterns are evolving and what resources will be needed to support reliable service over the long term.


Businesses depend on reliable electricity to support expansion, maintain operations, and remain competitive


. Reliable and affordable power enables access to essential services, supports business growth, and helps create safe, connected, and thriving communities.


Utilities, meanwhile, must plan for additional generation resources and invest in critical infrastructure. The goal is to ensure long-term reliability while balancing affordability, sustainability, and evolving customer needs.


How Does Rising Electricity Demand Affect Me as a Customer


Rising demand can influence long-term infrastructure planning, resource development decisions, and energy procurement strategies. While impacts vary by region and customer type, utilities must plan years in advance to ensure sufficient resources are available to reliably meet future needs


.


What is Evergy Doing to Prepare for Future Demand


Meeting future demand requires a long-term strategic approach. Evergy continually evaluates future capacity needs to help ensure reliable service for customers as energy requirements evolve


.


This includes assessing new generation resources, monitoring reliability requirements, and planning infrastructure investments needed to support future growth. Long-term planning efforts help position the company to meet changing customer needs while maintaining a reliable energy system


.


Recognizing change and developing innovative solutions are fundamental to preparing for the future. By evaluating emerging technologies, monitoring market trends, and exploring new opportunities, Evergy is working to support the energy needs of tomorrow's customers and communities


.


How EEP Can Help


At Evergy Energy Partners (EEP), helping customers navigate an evolving energy landscape is a top


priority. The electricity demand is consistently growing and with that comes preparation.


EEP helps organizations prepare for future energy needs through energy supply planning, capacity analysis, on-site solar and battery storage solutions, cost management strategies, and long-term energy planning. Whether supporting business growth, facility expansion, or new development projects, EEP provides guidance to help customers make informed energy decisions.


By understanding each customer's goals, operational requirements, and future energy needs, EEP helps organizations develop strategies that support reliability, manage costs, and position them for long-term success in an increasingly complex energy environment.
